comment: mklev.c mklev_sanity_check() reporting "room N not connected?" on a level C really makes: with the sanity_check option on, a Priest improvises on a wished-for wooden harp until the tune has one note (svc.context.jingle, which svd.dungeons[-1].ledger_start overlays), wishes for a magic portal, which keeps maketrap()'s dst of {-1, -1}, and steps back onto it. makelevel() builds a room-and-corridor level of dungeon -1 on which makecorridors() leaves rooms 1-6 unjoined, and each report prints the full impossible() block outside sanity_check(). The recipe stops before the next divergence: after the level is made C prints a third builds_up() impossible() where the port prints "goto_level: no corresponding portal!". Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
